title: My new room
subtitle: Elif shows her mom her room — there is / there are
canDo: I can name rooms and things in a home.
I can use there is and there are.
teacherNotes: Warm-up: Öğrencilerden kameralarıyla odalarının bir köşesini göstermelerini ve 2 şey söylemelerini isteyin ("There's a desk. There are two lamps.").
Türk öğrenciler "var" yüzünden have kullanabilir ("In my room have a bed"). Kural: bir yerde bir şey varsa there is / there are; sahiplik ise have.
Arap öğrenciler "يوجد"u "is" ile çevirebilir ("Is a window in the room?"). Soruda there'yi unutmasınlar: Is there…?
any bu derste sadece kalıp olarak (There aren't any…, Are there any…?). some / any Ünite 5'te ayrıntılı.

sections.title: Read
sections.heading: My apartment
sections.intro: Elif writes about her apartment in Boston.
paragraphs: My apartment is small, but I love it.
There's a kitchen, a bathroom and a bedroom.
There isn't a living room, so my bedroom is my living room, too!
In the kitchen, there's a small table and two chairs.

sections.title: Grammar: there is / there are
look: **There's** a bed, a desk and a chair.

head: one
two or more
rows: Yes, there is. / No, there isn't.
Yes, there are. / No, there aren't.

rules: Use **there is / there are** to say what is in a place.
**There's** + one thing · **There are** + two or more things
With plurals in negatives and questions, use **any**: There aren't **any** pictures. Are there **any** plants?
examples: There's a lamp on the desk.
There are three chairs in the kitchen.
Is there a park near here?
There isn't a TV in my room.

support.tr: Türkçedeki "var / yok" İngilizcede there is / there are ile söylenir: Odada bir yatak var = There's a bed in the room. Birden fazla şey için there are: İki pencere var = There are two windows. Yok: there isn't / there aren't. Soru: Is there …? Are there …? Dikkat: sahiplik anlamındaki "var" (Bir kardeşim var) have ile söylenir, there is ile değil.
support.ar: نستخدم there is / there are لنقول «يوجد / هناك»: There's a bed in the room = يوجد سرير في الغرفة. للمفرد there is، وللجمع there are: There are two windows = توجد نافذتان. للنفي: there isn't / there aren't، وللسؤال: Is there …? Are there …?

tr.note: Bir yerde bir şey "var"sa have değil there is / there are kullan.
wrong: In my room have a bed.
right: There's a bed in my room.

ar.note: لا تترجم «يوجد» بـ have أو بـ is وحدها.
wrong: In the kitchen have a table.
Is a window in your room?
right: There's a table in the kitchen.
Is there a window in your room?
